equipmentPolicy: Equip compatible owned items by a fixed stat score; no purchases, no selling, no personal-scenario rewards.
promotionPolicy: Use CampaignPromotion.TrySave when its real story and level requirements are satisfied; leave growth paths and traits at defaults.
plannerPolicy: Existing UtilityPlanner for allies and EnemyPlanner for enemies; one planned action per turn; existing legal node/exit approach after active enemies are gone.
trainingPolicy: Before each stage, selected allies below the real entry recommendation use TacticalDevelopment.CatchUp; EXP reset is recorded.
limitations: Not human playtesting. Does not exercise dialogue/UI, follow-up timing inputs, deliberate boss telegraph dodging, optimal gear choice, optional scenarios, purchases or retries. A planner defeat/limit is an audit observation, not proof that players cannot clear the stage. Battle-start profile initialization mirrors BattleDirector.BeginBattle; there is no in-battle recovery or stat injection.
